title: E0086: Deprecated session function
plain_english: Deprecated session functions `session_register()`, `session_is_registered()`, and `session_unregister()` were removed in PHP 5.4. Use the `$_SESSION` superglobal instead.
why_matters: These functions no longer exist in PHP 5.4 and later, so code that uses them will cause fatal errors. `$_SESSION` is the supported way to manage session data.
